shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 109.79 km effective diameter (catalog ±1.54 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation; the grid marks unavailable imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 54.895 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
